mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_user_push_token ( user_id , push_token , use_yn , allow_yn , device_type , browser_name , platform , user_agent , device_name , frst_reg_dt , last_mdf_dt , last_seen_dt ) VALUES ( #{userId} , #{pushToken} , 'Y' , 'Y' , #{deviceType} , #{browserName} , #{platform} , #{userAgent} , #{deviceName} , (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') , (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') , (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul') ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, push_token) DO UPDATE SET use_yn = 'Y', allow_yn = 'Y', device_type = #{deviceType}, browser_name = #{browserName}, platform = #{platform}, user_agent = #{userAgent}, device_name = #{deviceName}, last_mdf_dt = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul'), last_seen_dt = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')
mapper.select: SELECT a.user_id, t.push_token, COUNT(*) AS odoc_cnt, MIN(a.odoc_sn) AS odoc_sn, STRING_AGG(a.odoc_nm, ', ' ORDER BY a.odoc_nm) AS odoc_names FROM t_odoc_main a JOIN t_user_push_token t ON a.user_id = t.user_id AND t.use_yn = 'Y' AND t.allow_yn = 'Y' WHERE a.odoc_alarm_yn = 'Y' AND TO_CHAR(a.odoc_alarm_time, 'HH24:MI') = #{nowHm} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_odoc_dtl d WHERE d.user_id = a.user_id AND d.odoc_sn = a.odoc_sn AND DATE(d.odoc_dt) = (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date ) GROUP BY a.user_id, t.push_token
SELECT push_token FROM t_user_push_token WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND use_yn = 'Y'
